scope: Final measured SYCL tuning on the listed workstation. Background host workloads remained active; filesystem caches were not cleared. Kernel timings exclude transfers and CPU expert misses. Whole-model comparisons below are three-run medians, with profiling unset.

kernel_microbenchmark.statistic: median event interval divided by graph repetitions
kernel_microbenchmark.reference: STRATA_SYCL_IQ_ESIMD=0, old=0 (existing eight-row grouped path and Q2 XMX enabled)
kernel_microbenchmark.quality: All 56 result arrays bitwise equal to their reference, including 14 complete grouped expert/SwiGLU/quantize/down cases.

validation.quantized_prefill: 17 formats, routed row maps, stride guards, invalid bounds, aligned vector and unaligned scalar gathers passed
validation.persistent_engine_full_esimd: two 128-token writing requests, two 128-token coding requests, cancellation and 8-token recovery; output ids equal to baseline; exit 0
validation.note: Persistent full-ESIMD trial includes first-use compilation and overlapped host compilation; it is a correctness check, not final performance evidence.

full_ctest.scope: All default CTest targets; packed prototype was compiled but disabled by default. All retained kernel changes included.

validation.packed_prototype_model: Prefill16 workers5: all completed 128-token requests bitwise-id equal to baseline. Prefill1024: all completed ids equal to preceding phase-one run at the same chunk. Both passed STOP during prefill, STOP during decode and eight-token recovery.

layer_boundary_cancel.scope: First alternating comparison; same prefill16 and output ids. Remaining trials are recorded separately for final medians.

prefill_screen.conditions: One exploratory process per condition; 827 input ids, 826 prefetched, 8 outputs, context 2048, fixed 1649 profile-filled slots, adaptive swaps disabled, MTP4/.9, four workers, PLE direct I/O. Profiling enabled. Some early baseline runs overlap host compilation. These select candidates for repeated timing, not final estimates.

rejected_copy_queue.ordinary_cross_queue_event_waits: Both copy and compute engines remained busy while main and host stager threads waited; process terminated by the test operator. GDB trace archived.
rejected_copy_queue.host_wait_at_ring_reuse: Completed and retained all eight output ids; no advantage against the fastest single-queue setting.

worker_screen.conditions: One process per count; phase-one binary 61ab83d, prefill16, context512, automatic cache (2137 compact native slots), 64 swaps, MTP4/.9, 128 generated tokens per request; no host compilation overlapped these runs. All completed-request ids matched baseline-1. Worker count excludes the host thread.

packed_group_screen.conditions: One paired normal execution with profiling unset, 826 prefetched tokens, chunk1024, context2048, fixed1649 slots, four workers, no adaptation. Prototype applies after the layer-boundary cancellation change.
packed_group_screen.reason: Normal prompt time improved only 0.8% in this pair; short-prompt screens showed no improvement. This is insufficient evidence to add the host packing path and its 42.6 MB host buffers.

persistent_final.conditions: Three alternating before/after pairs, then three selected-preset runs. Two 128-token writing requests, two 128-token coding requests, STOP at 50 ms during a fresh prompt, STOP after first output, then eight-token recovery. Context512, auto cache2137 slots, MTP4 floor0.9, adapt64.
persistent_final.after: Final binary, prefill16, workers5; matched output comparison
persistent_final.preset: Final binary, prefill1024, workers5; compared to the prior 1024-chunk reference
persistent_final.cancellation_timing: Reported wall time is GEN-to-DONE with STOP scheduled at50ms, not directly measured STOP-to-DONE latency.
